blocks.text: OUR MEETINGS WITH OUR ASIAN CLIENTS ARE NOTHING UNUSUAL.
AND WE HAVE NO COMMENT ON INTELLIGENCE REPORTS.
THE ONES ON THE INSIDE WON'T TALK. I NEED SOMEONE WHO GOT OUT... THROUGH THE BACK DOOR.
HIM. FORMER EXECUTIVE, PUSHED OUT LAST YEAR. HE MUST HAVE SCORES TO SETTLE.
FRENCH JOURNALIST.|LOOKING FOR SOMEONE|WHO KNOWS THE HOUSE|FROM THE INSIDE.
NOT HERE. NOT IN WRITING.|HONG KONG. TEMPLE STREET.|THURSDAY, 9 P.M.
